title: A Framework for Auditing Chatbots for Dialect-Based Quality-of-Service Harms

bias_targets.methodology: Dynamically generating user prompts in multiple minoritized English dialects (e.g., African American English, Appalachian English, Chicano English, Indian English, Singaporean English) using the Multi-VALUE transformation tool, perturbing them with variations in formality and typos, querying the target chatbot (Amazon Rufus), and evaluating the responses for quality-of-service harms such as unsureness and factual incorrectness.
